questionText: The price mechanism relies on two key assumptions in order to allocate resources efficiently. Which of the following correctly states both?

questionText: Which of the following best describes how the price mechanism leads to market clearing?
answers: Government intervention in the market ensures that there is no shortage or surplus and that the market clears

questionText: When the price mechanism works well, economists say it achieves allocative efficiency. What does this mean?
answers: The economy produces goods and services at the lowest possible cost per unit
The economy produces the goods and services that consumers most want, in the quantities they want
The economy produces as many goods and services as possible, regardless of what consumers want
The government decides which goods and services should be produced
